Candidates are cat, dog, and hedgehog, so I want a question that separates one of them from the other two. None of the listed questions clearly does that.

Of the options, "Is it soft?" is the most promising. Cat and dog would likely get yes, and hedgehog (spiky) would get no, which gives a 2/1 split. "Can you hold it in one hand?" is weaker: a hedgehog fits, a cat arguably doesn't, and a small dog is ambiguous.

I'll go with "Is it soft?"
